title: A Different Definition of "Hero"
subtitle: A loyal soldier with a penchant for foul language and deep-fried critters.

items.text: Main Exhibition Hall, Polymer Exhibition Hall
The trio follows Left into the exhibition hall's main gallery.
It is a horror show of destruction and violence. Broken robots lie among piles of collapsed rubble. A few surviving scientists have holed up in a far corner.
Right is arranging a few round white objects on the floor.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What's that on the ground?

items.speaker: Left
items.text: A defensive perimeter of pulse mines. These will temporarily stun robots but are harmless to humans.
Left delicately lowers the scientist's corpse down on the right side of the gallery, where a few other corpses have already been set down, covered in hastily torn white cloth.
Left and Right then glance at each other and nod.

items.speaker: Right
items.text: You shouldn't be here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We found a survivor.
Following the young visitors' gestures, Right spots the writhing cocoon of the still-struggling scientist.

items.speaker: Right
items.text: Understood.
Right approaches and brings him over to the other survivors. Meanwhile, Left approaches a nearby control terminal.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Attempting to reassert admin privileges over exhibition hall controls ... Attempt 16: Failure.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Please do not panic, comrades. Help will arrive shortly.

items.speaker: Right
items.text: A special operations agent will take responsibility over evacuating you safely.

items.speaker: Right
items.text: The malfunctioning robots may resume their assault at any time. Please stay behind the defensive perimeter.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm?

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Is that another haywire robot?
The Twins unite and float into the air.

items.speaker: Left & Right
items.text: No hostiles detected.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The sound's getting closer. Get ready to fight.
Crispy critters! I should just blow this entire door to bits.
The explosion sends smoke and dust flying in all directions. The young visitors fan their hands in front of them, trying to get a clear view.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: *coughing* I heard ... Don't tell me some kind of Critter caused this.
Outta my way!
The figure in the smoke kicks something metallic. After the blast settles, the exhibition hall is filled with the sound of metal skidding across the floor.
What good is a lock like that, Char-les? Was it just to keep idiots out?
A tall, broad man toting a gun emerges from the billowing smoke.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Who is this?

items.speaker: X
items.text: He doesn't appear to be a robot anyways, and I don't think he's gone mad like that scientist.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Are you certain of that? It looks like he's arguing with his glove.

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: Don't be so testy, Major! As long as I'm here, those locks won't be any trouble for you.
They wouldn't be able to stop me even without ya.

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: Mmm. I don't deny that. But I could have contacted the Twins and asked them to open the door instead.
Why didn't ya tell me that before I blew it up?!

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: I didn't want to interrupt your fun.
The Twins exit their alert state and slowly descend from the air.
What happened? And what the hell are these kids doing here?
The man looks over the three of them as he passes. Then he walks over to the Twins, brushes some debris off his shoulder, and pounds his chest.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Code name P-3.

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: And his trusty companion, Char-les.

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: We were informed about an incident at the Polymer Exhibition Hall. Our orders are to bring a swift end to this situation and limit any scandal that might hamper the launch of Kollektiv 2.0.

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: In other words, Dr. Sechenov sent us to assist you. Now, we just need to find out who did this.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Understood.

items.speaker: Right
items.text: Dr. Sechenov has confirmed that this was a targeted attack on the Kollektiv 2.0 launch.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Ha, that's obvious! Anybody able to hack into the exhibition's controls has gotta have some serious backing. Lotsa people resent the boss—think he's in the way of their own ambitions.

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: Like Molotov, or any of the various enemies of the Soviet Union.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Molotov ... That's the man who shook hands with Dr. Sechenov in the lecture hall.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Hold on. You mean he actually showed up? Where's he now?

items.speaker: Left
items.text: Comrade Molotov left in a car shortly after Dr. Sechenov's speech concluded.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Hmph, he sure made a quick exit.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Alright, thanks for the report, ladies. You can stand down. I'll take care of things from here.

items.speaker: Left
items.text: We have not received orders to conclude our mission. These survivors still require protection.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: I've got that covered too. Char-les, gimme the data on our survivors. Start with those kids.
P-3 opens his palm toward the young visitors. The tendrils in his glove swirl and snap. Their movements seem almost like they were snatching information from thin air.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Ah, this may cause a predicament.
X covers the nametag at his chest, trying to hide his identity from the machine's gaze.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Gentlemen, we're scientists from abroad who were invited to participate in the summit. Your database might not have information on us.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I think it'd be better to introduce ourselves directly. My name is Vertin. This is Mesmer Jr., and that's X.
The glove's tendrils seem to slow, almost as if they were thinking.

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: She's right, Major. I have no data on them. Though I can tell that those two haven't been polymerized.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Not polymerized?! Crispy critters! Hardly see that these days!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Perhaps it's better to focus our efforts on searching for and rescuing other survivors.

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: Hmm, I also notice that their names don't appear in any available immigration records and that they were only added to the guest list for the summit earlier today.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: You mean they snuck in?

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: It would appear so.
P-3 lifts his gun to his shoulder, looking over the trio with suspicion.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Major ...

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Hmm, so we've got potential spies at the site of a complete disaster?

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Teenage spies, hmph. What'll they stoop to next?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's not like that, Major. Please allow me to explain.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Where should I send 'em, Char-les?

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: That's complicated. Perhaps the Juvenile Justice Committee, or a counterintelligence agency.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Any ideas, X?

items.speaker: X
items.text: The signal here isn't great. Maybe your glove should check again?

items.speaker: Char-les
items.text: That isn't funny.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: We should run.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Concurred.
The three of them make a break for it. P-3 immediately gives chase, only to stop with an annoyed realization.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Garr, can't get any info if they're dead. Hey, Twins! Help me catch 'em—alive! We'll each take one. Got it?

items.speaker: Left & Right
items.text: Understood.
The Twins fly after the young visitors. Left quickly catches up to Mesmer Jr. and reaches for her arm.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Take this!
X turns around with his hand raised, like he's about to throw something.
He opens his hand to reveal a teleport disk, flashing a devilish grin at the Twins before activating it.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hmph, made you look!
As soon as the words leave his lips, a blinding light envelops the trio. Then just as quickly as it appeared, the light vanishes, taking the three visitors along with it.

items.speaker: P-3
items.text: Errrr. Was that magic?
